quote: Beginning on March 6, 2024, we announced a series of new contractual agreements with CoreWeave, Inc. (“CoreWeave”), a third-party provider of high-performance computing (“HPC”) operations for customers using specialized graphics processing units (“GPUs”).
issuer_treatment: H1 2025 : activité de colocation CoreWeave, transition depuis le minage et risque de non-performance du client unique ; aucune preuve ici de financements additionnels ou de cash reçu de ce client.
